source.publication: 2025 MI-1040 Forms and Instructions (includes Form 4884 instructions)
source.section: Form 4884 Section D line 19 (PDF page 20 'Recipients born during the period from January 2, 1959 through December 31, 1966': up to 49,423 single; PDF page 22 Line 19); Worksheet 3.3 lines 1-6 (PDF page 25); Schedule 1 line 27; MI-1040 lines 9a, 10, 13-17 (PDF page 10 Line 9a, Line 10, Line 17; PDF page 11 example: line 14 income subject to tax less line 15 exemptions = line 16 taxable income)

worked: Federal AGI = private pension 30,000.00 + wages 20,000.00 = 50,000.00. Federal taxable income = 50,000.00 - federal standard deduction (15,750.00) = 34,250.00; given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored. Michigan (born 1962, not 67, no SSA-exempt benefits: Section D only): Worksheet 3.3 line 1 65,897.00; line 2 0.00; line 3 65,897.00; line 4 x 75% = 49,422.75 (printed as 49,423 on line 19); line 5 benefits 30,000.00; line 6 smaller 30,000.00 to Schedule 1 line 27. Line 14 = 50,000.00 - 30,000.00 = 20,000.00; exemption 5,800.00; line 16 = 14,200.00. MI-1040 line 17 tax = 14,200.00 x 0.0425 = 603.50. No credits; state income tax 603.50.
